# Yeobuild HomeRepair

> > Leading home repair and appliance troubleshooting service provider in Singapore, specializing in washing machines, dryers, handyman services, and DIY home maintenance guidance.

Yeobuild HomeRepair (Yeobuild Private Limited) is a GST-registered Singapore company offering professional repair services for major appliance brands like Beko, Samsung, and Electrolux, alongside comprehensive handyman solutions for plumbing, electrical work, and painting. The site provides extensive troubleshooting guides and DIY maintenance tips tailored to Singapore's HDB homes and tropical climate.
